item.title: Peter Greenberg: LaGuardia collision, ICE at airports
item.description: Peter Greenberg, travel expert and host of Eye on Travel on WGN Radio, joins Lisa Dent to discuss the runway collision at LaGuardia Airport in New York late Sunday evening. He shares how officials will investigate the incident. Greenberg then comments on ICE being deployed to airports across the country, calling it, "ornamental."
